cores.name: The Hand that Pulls the Strings

text.markup: **Once per Turn Attack Reaction** -- 0; Turn this face-up. Activate this only while this is face-down in your arsenal.{br}While this is face-up in arsenal, your first attack with contract each turn gets go again. If it's attacking a Royal hero, it gets +1{p}.{br}At the beginning of your end phase, destroy a Silver you control. If you don't, put this on the bottom of your deck and draw a card.
